rea_turner_deloria_historiography_2002.note: Dedicated Dickason review 2026-10-25: p.10 second paragraph freshly read and visually checked for its explicit treatment of Dickason’s 1984 book alongside Gordon Sayre as extending discourse/image scholarship to the French. This is a named resource within Deloria’s survey, not a claim of personal mentoring or first reading of Dickason’s whole book. Existing Turner and Wilson claims and their qualifications remain unchanged.
